title: Melatonin impairs morning cognition in healthy young adults (2023)
summary: A peer-reviewed study examining how melatonin supplementation affects next-morning cognitive performance in healthy young adults, finding that melatonin intake impairs morning cognition.
problem_solved: Investigates whether melatonin supplementation causes next-day cognitive impairment in young, healthy individuals.
why_valuable: Provides important clinical evidence for safe melatonin use timing, helping consumers and healthcare providers understand potential cognitive trade-offs of taking melatonin before sleep.
